_about: Rows read from Trustpilot pages in the browser on 2026-11-07, text copied exactly as shown. Each row: [review id, date, rating, text]. URL = https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/<id>. Where a review had no body, the title is used as text. Long reviews are kept as an exact contiguous excerpt (whole paragraphs, unaltered); names of the companies' staff were left out by excerpting around them.
wati:
Wati is a terrible software with hidden charges and poor customer service. Even after requesting them to cancel our subscription, they are not processing the cancellation. We are no longer using their services, yet they continue to charge us.

Highly disappointing experience. I would strongly recommend others to avoid Wati. **Would not recommend it to anyone.**

At first glance, the product seems to offer a good range of features and appears to be quite comprehensive. However, it comes with Meta's usual limitations and restrictions. For example, sending the same message to multiple people you haven't contacted frequently in a short period of time—such as wedding invitations—can result in your whatsapp being blocked.

But the most frustrating part is trying to cancel the subscription. There is no way to cancel directly through the website. Instead, you have to go through a chat, where a bot tells you that a verification email will be sent to continue the process (still don't know what the rest of such process is). I'm still waiting for that email.

To make matters worse, their cancellation policy states that you must request cancellation at least three days before your renewal date.

A product may have great features, but making it this difficult to cancel a subscription is unacceptable. It seriously undermines trust in the service.

Very disappointing experience with WATI.

The WATI AI support response is honestly pathetic. If someone is genuinely interested in giving your company business, why make them struggle with an AI instead of connecting them with an actual human?

I am based in Dubai but want to use WATI for a business in India. Every time I visit your website, I am redirected to the UAE/local site instead of being able to properly explore the India offering. The website experience is already frustrating, and unfortunately, the customer support is no better.

I specifically asked your AI support to arrange a callback, but despite that request, nobody has contacted me. This is a basic business enquiry, and if WATI cannot even respond to a potential customer who is actively trying to buy your service, it raises serious concerns about the level of support after becoming a customer.

WATI should seriously rethink its customer support approach. Your competitors will gladly take business from you if you continue making potential customers work this hard just to speak to someone.

Has to be the worst support system I have seen for any software or SaaS brands. Incredibly slow and poor management of tickets. It will take days to sort out issues, even if the issue is halting your business, they don't care. #1 in the poorest service table. Their support team is non existent.

Unfortunately, our experience with WATI has been very disappointing.

Since day one, we experienced functionality issues with WhatsApp calling. When clients called us, we often could not hear them, meaning we had to hang up and call them back every time. This made the calling functionality practically unusable for our business.

We reported the issue more than three times, but instead of receiving proper technical or personal support, we mostly received automated/AI-style responses that did not resolve the problem. For a business communication platform, the lack of effective human support was particularly frustrating.

As the system was not functioning properly for our needs, we requested a refund. This was declined. We had also purchased additional conversation credits and still have approximately USD 50 remaining, but we were informed that this balance would not be refunded either.

Overall, we paid for a service that did not function reliably for us, received inadequate support despite repeatedly reporting the issue, and were unable to recover our remaining credit balance.

Based on our experience, I cannot recommend WATI.

Our experience with WATI has been one of the worst we have had with a software provider.

We purchased the service specifically because of features and API functionality described in WATI’s own documentation. After implementation, we discovered that key functionality simply did not work as documented.

We spent significant time testing, debugging and communicating with their support/developer team. Even their developers were unable to make the advertised functionality work or provide a working solution.

The most frustrating part is that we were effectively unable to use the product for its intended purpose — we could not even properly send/use the service we had purchased — yet when we requested a refund, WATI refused and simply referred to their Terms & Conditions.

In my opinion, hiding behind refund terms when a customer cannot use the functionality described in your own documentation is unacceptable.

So the situation was basically:

• Documentation says the functionality is available.
• We purchase the product based on that documentation.
• The functionality does not work.
• Their technical team cannot solve it.
• We cannot properly use the service.
• We request a refund.
• WATI keeps the money and points to their Terms & Conditions.

Before paying WATI, I would strongly recommend testing every critical feature you need and getting written confirmation that it actually works in your specific setup. Do not assume that because something is described in their documentation it will necessarily work as expected.

For us, this was a complete waste of time and money, and the way the refund request was handled made the experience significantly worse.

I strongly advise businesses not to connect WATI to their main business number or existing Meta assets without a complete technical and legal assessment.

After external WhatsApp automation was connected to our environment, our Meta Business was restricted and one of our telephone numbers was permanently blocked. Meta specifically referred to apparent automation that did not comply with its policies. We cannot conclusively prove that WATI alone caused the restriction, but the timing and the problems are documented.

We repeatedly experienced difficulties with setup, approvals and customer support. When we decided to leave WATI completely, our login was disabled. There was no simple self-service cancellation or deletion process. To delete the account, release our telephone numbers and WABA, and remove WATI’s access from Meta, we had to create an external support ticket.

For a business-critical platform, we consider this exit process unacceptable. We are still waiting for written confirmation that all billing, telephone numbers, WABA connections, tokens, webhooks and Meta permissions have been completely terminated.

My experience: 1 out of 5 stars. Based on what our company experienced, I cannot recommend WATI. Before using this service, companies should carefully verify ownership of their telephone numbers and Meta assets, as well as the complete exit and disconnection process.

Having recently adjusted my business operations, I decided to downgrade from an annual Pro plan to a monthly Growth plan to evaluate whether to keep the service.

Three weeks before my renewal, I downgraded my account directly on their website, just as I had done in past years. However, Wati has quietly changed how this works: if you have active features (like chatbots) exceeding the lower plan's limits, the downgrade silently fails at the renewal date. Instead of automatically deactivating those features (like in the past) or blocking the downgrade outright until the account fits the limits, their system lets you proceed and then defaults to charging your card for another full $950 annual renewal.

When the billing date arrived, I was shocked to see a $950 charge hit my account. I contacted support within 6 hours of the charge.

They misled us in terms of what the tool actually was versus what we were looking for. We were looking for a WhatsApp marketing tool. They basically had an incoming/outcoming messaging tool, and I signed up for it. They were not forthcoming in all the way it should have been run and what it was supposed to do. Instead, they misled us. When I asked for a refund within two days of signing up, they basically said, "Oh, because we spent time with you onboarding you or giving you a call, we are not going to refund you."

Every interaction has felt like starting from scratch — repeated back-and-forth, generic troubleshooting steps that had already been tried, and no clear escalation to someone who could actually diagnose the root cause. For a business-critical tool, this level of support responsiveness is simply not acceptable.

aisensy:
I have been unable to access or properly use the product I paid for, and it has now been 10 days since I formally requested a refund.

During those 10 days, I have made countless phone calls, repeatedly followed up with customer support, and requested that the matter be escalated. Every single time, the process has been stalled, with no meaningful resolution.

We signed up expecting a functional WhatsApp automation platform that would help streamline our business operations. Instead, we have spent an unreasonable amount of time dealing with technical issues, including problems accessing and using the platform as intended.

What makes the experience particularly frustrating is the customer service. Support has been ridiculously slow, unnecessarily laborious, and largely ineffective. There has been an extraordinary amount of back-and-forth with very little meaningful progress. Simple issues seem to require endless follow-ups, yet nothing actually gets resolved.

Their dashboard clearly stated “Share your feedback about AiSensy Platform & earn WCC instantly” and “Get upto 5000 messages for FREE!” I followed the process, but the WCC was not provided. Later, their team introduced eligibility conditions that were not clearly mentioned in the campaign.

What was more frustrating was being pushed toward a paid plan from around the 3rd day of the 14-day trial, while the WCC issue was still unresolved.

How are customers supposed to properly evaluate the ROI of the platform if they aren't given the promised credits to actually use and test it during the trial period?

Not a good Platform to work with. 1- Their support is name sake. They will give wrong information to make you pay, then they will not refund but will adjust your money in a future plan. also you cannot call them, you have to mail or whatsapp that is conveniently ignored.
Waste of money ,switching to another platform

AiSensy has been an excellent platform for managing our WhatsApp campaigns, chatbots, and customer support. Its interface is very user-friendly, smooth, and easy to set up, making it accessible even for first-time users.

The so-called “AI Chatbot” is nothing more than a set of rigid, templated responses and cannot genuinely be considered AI-driven. There is no real intelligence or adaptability in the system. Implementation was entirely left to us—we had to configure the workflows on our own by watching a series of videos, and when questions arose, there was no support available to assist us. Messages and inquiries went unanswered. We were explicitly told that a Relationship Manager would be assigned even under a prepaid 3-month plan, but this never happened. This was a clear misrepresentation.

I paid over $150 for a subscription and conversation credits, but the software never worked. Even though I consumed 0 credits, they flatly refused to issue a refund, blatantly ignoring their own refund policy (Section 4) and breaking written promises made by their support staff in the chat.

The onboarding process is a trap: They offer 'temporary numbers' that they know will be rejected by Meta’s policies, and then they blame the customer for the failure. Instead of solving the issue, they try to force you into more costs and technical work.
Their support is worse; even scammer support is better than their support

For the last 6 months, I’ve spent 4 months just reporting bugs and waiting endlessly for fixes.

AiSensy promises a 24-hour support response time, but in reality, I’m getting replies after 2–3 days — sometimes even longer.

It’s been 20+ days since my current issue was raised, and I’m still waiting for a real solution.

I’ve filed 28+ bug reports and complaints — yes, twenty-eight — and the same issues keep coming back.

The app logs out randomly, crashes frequently, and doesn’t perform as advertised.

Even deactivated accounts keep receiving messages, which makes absolutely no sense for a business platform.

In my case, I wanted to send tracking details to my consumers. Their documentation clearly mentions this attribute, but it didn’t work. Instead of fixing it, they arranged a meeting and told me it was a WooCommerce issue that I should handle myself. When I suggested a workaround—just give me a custom meta field where I could enter the value—they agreed, but then tried to charge me for it.

First, they mention the feature in their documentation, and then later they charge extra for it. That’s completely unprofessional.
